question: What Activity authentication boundary should OpenClaw require before Discord Activities can access A2UI from a public Discord client?
rationale: The current patch changes Gateway/Canvas auth behavior and exposes A2UI outside normal bearer or node-capability auth, so the permanent token/capability/cookie model needs maintainer security intent before implementation can be finalized.

options.title: Require credentialed Canvas-plugin Activity access
options.body: Move Activity config to the Canvas plugin and require a non-URL credential or scoped capability before A2UI HTTP/WS access is allowed.

options.title: Pause the Activity bridge
options.body: Keep only the Discord launch-button work or docs until the A2UI public-access model is designed separately.

options.title: Accept URL-token access
options.body: Allow query-token Activity access as an explicitly documented operator risk, which keeps the PR direction but weakens the Gateway security boundary.

recommendation.title: Require credentialed Canvas-plugin Activity access
recommendation.body: Move Activity config to the Canvas plugin and require a non-URL credential or scoped capability before A2UI HTTP/WS access is allowed.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is centered on Canvas/Gateway auth and plugin config ownership, where current history points most strongly to Peter Steinberger.
